changelog: The draft your coding agent prepared in the terminal can now be decided from Vibe Buddy on the Mac. Open a conversation in Buddy and, if /vibe prepared a message for that person in a session, the composer shows it exactly as the terminal preview did — recipient, why now, the words — with Send, Edit and Discard. Send goes back through this package with the revision you saw, so there is one draft, one sender and one approval digest, never two sends. Edit moves the words into your own box and discards the draft; what you send after that is plainly your own. Discard here is discard everywhere.
features: vibe-draft CLI: list | send <id> <rev> | discard <id> — the terminal's drafts for another surface on the same machine, through the same store, lock, rev-bound claim and approval digest
Buddy 0.5.72+ shows a previewed draft in its composer and decides through this package; Buddy never posts a draft's text itself
An unconfirmed send stays reachable (Send again retries exactly the same text, once); discard reports whether an earlier attempt may already have reached them
A draft whose sending process died is reconciled and listed as unknown, never hidden
